name: image-tab2
blurb: Alternate image tabs layout with side-by-side preview.
description: Tab layout variant (same component as image-tab1, different demo). Shows tabs on left, image preview on right. Uses TabsProvider and sub-components.
use_when: Gallery or portfolio where side-by-side layout is preferred.
avoid_when: Narrow viewports; side-by-side needs horizontal space.
a11y: Tab buttons are keyboard-navigable. Images have alt text. Descriptions are semantic.
